name: MT Messe Stand Services
description: Exhibition stand design, manufacturing and installation services for international trade fairs

services.name: Custom Wooden Stands
services.description: Full custom builds — curved walls, integrated LED screens, suspended ceilings, branded floor finishes. 18–800m², 3–6 weeks delivery.

services.name: Maxima Modular Stands
services.description: Aluminium frame system with fabric graphics, backlit panels, seamless connections. Premium look at 30–40% less cost. Reusable across multiple fairs.

services.name: Enhancing Package Stands
services.description: Overlay printed fabric graphics, add lighting, furniture and flooring to shell scheme stands. Transforms a generic booth into a branded space.

services.name: Country Pavilion Solutions
services.description: National pavilions, trade ministry stands, group exhibits. Complete pavilion design, identity, construction, logistics and onsite management.

services.name: Turn-key Exhibitor Services
services.description: Furniture rental, AV equipment, hostess service, graphic printing, catering coordination — everything beyond the booth itself.

services.name: Turn-key Organizer Services
services.description: Pre-built package stands, bulk furniture rental, lanyards, tote bags, trophies, registration counters — turn-key solutions for exhibition organizers.
